name: Sprites Sandbox
description: Run OpenClaw sandboxed tool execution inside Fly.io Sprites.

cliCommands.name: sprites
cliCommands.description: Inspect and wake Fly.io Sprites used as OpenClaw sandboxes

token.description: Sprites API token: a string or a SecretRef object. Falls back to SPRITES_TOKEN.

token.label: Sprites token
token.help: Sprites API token (string or SecretRef). Falls back to the SPRITES_TOKEN environment variable.

sandbox.namePrefix.label: Sprite name prefix
sandbox.namePrefix.help: Every sandbox sprite is named <prefix><Gateway-and-scope hash>. Match it to the token's name_prefix policy.

sandbox.instanceId.label: Gateway instance ID
sandbox.instanceId.help: Stable ownership ID for this Gateway. Generated and persisted automatically when omitted.

sandbox.labels.label: Extra labels
sandbox.labels.help: Additional labels applied to sandbox sprites.

sandbox.runtime.label: Runtime
sandbox.runtime.help: Sprite runtime variant: default or dev.

sandbox.sprite.label: Sprite size
sandbox.sprite.help: ramMB, cpus, region, storageGB for new sprites.

sandbox.network.label: Network policy
sandbox.network.help: Egress allowlist applied when a sprite is created.

sandbox.privileges.label: Privileges policy
sandbox.privileges.help: Process privilege profile applied at creation.

sandbox.checkpointAfterSetup.label: Checkpoint after setup
sandbox.checkpointAfterSetup.help: Take a checkpoint once the workspace is seeded and setupCommand has run; `openclaw sprites reset` restores it.

sandbox.remoteAgentWorkspaceDir.label: Remote agent dir
sandbox.remoteAgentWorkspaceDir.help: Mirror of the agent workspace when workspaceAccess is read-only.

timeoutSeconds.label: Request timeout
timeoutSeconds.help: Timeout for control-plane and setup requests.

wake.label: Sleep and wake
wake.help: timeoutSeconds: how long to wait for a suspended sprite to resume (default 120). keepAwakeMinutes: keep the sprite awake this long after the last tool call (default 0 = let it sleep).

sandbox.maxRunAfterDisconnect.label: Run after disconnect
sandbox.maxRunAfterDisconnect.help: How long a command may keep running after the Gateway disconnects (default 10s).

sandbox.label: Sandbox backend
sandbox.help: Settings for running OpenClaw sandboxed tools inside sprites (backend: "sprites").
